comments.body:
Quest name: Drawings on rock walls (Chrono Quest - 14th Century)
Quest location: St. Petersburg Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r7 Recognition, r9 Archaeology, CHN(Chinese)
Pre-requisite discovery: Xanadu discovery (from "The promised future" quest) + Twyfelfontein discovery (from "Cliff Face Drawings" quest)
Additional note: "Aftermath" part of Xanadu/Great Adventurer questchain

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body: This will be one of the requirements for High Seeker other than the majestic Xanadu itself...
